title: An Operator-Based Visual Analytics Pipeline for Synthetic Systemic Risk Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2609.22202v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This work presents an operator-based visual analytics pipeline for exploring synthetic systemic risk dynamics in financial networks. The framework is formulated as a composition of mathematical operators that sequentially transform synthetic financial observations into dynamic scientific visualizations.   The pipeline consists of six operators: latent risk mapping, probabilistic score generation, financial network construction, distance-based contagion dynamics, visual encoding, and perspective projection. Together, these operators provide a modular computational structure linking nonlinear risk surfaces, time-dependent probabilistic states, network topology, and shock propagation.   A reproducible implementation demonstrates the architecture through controlled synthetic experiments. Nonlinear latent risk representations are converted into probabilistic scores, embedded in a weighted financial network, and propagated via shortest-path co

translated_title: 一种基于算子的合成系统性风险动态可视化分析流水线
translated_abstract: 本工作提出了一种基于算子的可视化分析流水线，用于探索金融网络中的合成系统性风险动态。该框架被表述为一系列数学算子的组合，这些算子依次将合成金融观测数据转化为动态的科学可视化。该流水线由六个算子组成：潜在风险映射、概率评分生成、金融网络构建、基于距离的传染动态、视觉编码以及透视投影。这些算子共同提供了一个模块化的计算结构，将非线性风险表面、时间相关的概率状态、网络拓扑结构与冲击传播过程联系起来。通过受控的合成实验，一个可复现的实现展示了该架构。非线性潜在风险表示被转换为概率评分，嵌入到加权金融网络中，并通过最短路径传染机制进行传播。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种由六个数学算子（潜在风险映射、概率评分生成、金融网络构建、距离传染动态、视觉编码和透视投影）组成的模块化可视化分析流水线，可将合成金融观测数据依次转化为动态科学可视化，从而探索金融网络中的系统性风险动态。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a modular operator-based visual analytics pipeline composed of six mathematical operators that sequentially transform synthetic financial observations into dynamic scientific visualizations, enabling the exploration of systemic risk dynamics in financial networks.
